title: In Postgres Enterprise Manager (PEM), webhook URLs are not validated, and the PEM agent does not… (CVE-2026-132663)
description: Postgres Enterprise Manager (PEM) versions prior to 10.6.1 do not validate webhook URLs, allowing users with alert configuration privileges to specify file:// URLs. When such a webhook is triggered, the PEM agent, running as root by default, reads the referenced local file and stores its contents in the PEM database's webhook error record, accessible to any PEM user. Starting from PEM 10.6.1, webhook URLs are restricted to http and https schemes.
